group.description: API group of the object. An empty string is the core group.

kind.description: Kind of the object, eg `Secret` or `ConfigMap`.

namespace.description: Namespace of the object. Defaults to the namespace of the Gateway.

items.description: A ConfigMap or Secret with CA certificates.

caCertificateRefs.description: References to the CA certificates that client certificates are validated against.

mode.description: Whether clients without a valid certificate are refused: `AllowValidOnly` or `AllowInsecureFallback`.

description: Validation of the certificate of clients.
